field.name: profile_edit_layout_custom
field.label: Custom Layout
field.description:
Supply custom substitution and content plugin supported HTML layout to display. The HTML supplied will already been enclosed in the profile edit form element so do not include a form element here. This includes support for the following additional substitutions: [title] (renders profile edit page title), [navigation] (renders all collected tab navigation), [tabs] (renders all tab content with tab navigation), [content] (renders all tab content), [title_TAB_ID] (renders tab title based off tab id), [content_TAB_ID] (renders tab contents based off tab id), [tab_TAB_ID] (renders tab contents based off tab id with tab navigation), [legend] (renders legend icons), [button_submit] (renders form submit button), [button_cancel] (renders form cancel button), and [integrations] (results of onBeforeUserProfileEditDisplay trigger).

Notice: This is purely visual. It will not affect form validation. If you fail to include fields that have been marked required the profile edit save will fail due to missing required field.
